items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Well, I used to know Jacques.

ctx.x: Did you ever know anybody who played harmonica with those short bands?

Uh, let me see, there was, uh, I don't know, this fellow's name, uh, they'd have good harmonica played too. He played drum too. Uh, uh, trying to let me think of it now. Who he played with? Played with, uh, Kid Clayton. Oh, not Jacques. Uh, Bushy Head fellow, the, what's his name, what's your name, what's your name? Well, I used to know Jacques.
